# Claude Code Environment Variables: Network and Proxy

These 72 environment variables of Claude Code `2.1.303` cover API addresses, proxies, TLS, time limits, and retries.
They help when Claude Code runs behind a company proxy or a slow network.
An environment variable is a named setting that you put in your shell or in the `env` key of `settings.json`.

## Example

Run `export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1` before `claude` to stop every request that is not needed to work.
Or put `{ "env": { "CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC": "1" } }` in `~/.claude/settings.json`.

## Variables

The marks are explained on the [index](Claude-Code-Env-Vars#marks).

| Name | Mark | What It Does | Value | Where It Works |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` | ✅ | Overrides the API endpoint. A non-first-party host changes first-party checks, such as tool search and Remote Control. | Text. An unset value or an Anthropic host counts as first party | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` | ✅ | Adds custom request headers. | Text. Split on new lines, each `Name: Value` at the first colon. Bad header names or values are dropped with a warning | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET` | ✅ | Sends first-party API requests over this Unix socket path. | Text. Passed as the `unix` fetch option. Also in the host-managed provider list with `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` | First-party API client, all. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | ✅ | Forces the streaming body idle timeout on or off. | A number. A true value forces it on and a false value (`0`) turns the fetch timeout off | Anthropic API client, all. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `API_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the API request timeout in milliseconds. | A number of milliseconds, per by default. Whole number. Errors show a hint to raise it | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO` | 🔍 | Names the CA bundle file for Cargo. Claude Code sets it to the sandbox CA bundle for sandboxed commands, next to `SSL_CERT_FILE` and others. | Text. Also in a list of CA env names | Sandboxed commands and remote sessions |
| `CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP` | ✅ | Names the client app of an Agent SDK host. Claude Code adds it to the user agent as `client-app/<value>`. | Text | SDK hosts. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION` | 🔍 | Reports the Agent SDK version. Claude Code adds it to the user agent as `agent-sdk/<value>`. | Text. The SDK host sets it | SDK hosts. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_GATEWAY_WITHHELD` | 🔍 | Names a gateway setting that the dispatcher did not pass to a background session. The session then prints a no-gateway hint. | Text. Active only when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` is unset. Scrubbed from child env | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BYTE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the idle timeout of the byte-level streaming watchdog. | A number of milliseconds. Whole number of `1` or more, clamped to `10000`-`1800000`. Else a first-party default of `180000` from a feature flag | API streaming. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_PROTECTION` | 🔍 | Adds the `x-anthropic-additional-protection: true` header to API requests. | On or off. Read when Claude Code builds the API client | API requests. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_API_BASE_URL` | 🔍 | Gives a fallback API base URL. The Files API uses it when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` is unset. Default `https://api.anthropic.com`. | Text. `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` wins when both are set. Credential checks also treat it as a base URL source | First-party API and Files API. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_LIVE_BASE_URL` | 🔍 | It is a URL setting in the typed schema and sits in a list of artifact base URL names. Nothing reads it, and a [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes) run saw no effect. | Text | Artifacts |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_SYNC_BASE_URL` | 🔍 | It is a URL setting in the typed schema and sits in a list of artifact base URL names. Nothing reads it, and a [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes) run saw no effect. | Text | Artifacts |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_VIEWER_BASE_URL` | 🔍 | It is a URL setting in the typed schema and sits in a list of artifact base URL names. Nothing reads it, and a [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes) run saw no effect. | Text | Artifacts |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER` | ✅ | Controls the attribution block at the start of the system prompt. A falsy value such as `0` omits it. | Text. Policy settings have a rule for it. Repo-committed settings may not re-point it | First-party API, not `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE` | ✅ | Chooses the CA certificate sources for TLS. | A comma-separated list, `bundled,system` by default | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT` | ✅ | Gives the path of the client certificate file for mTLS. | Text. Claude Code reads the file and skips a cert and key that do not match | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY` | ✅ | Gives the path of the client private key file for mTLS. | Text. Claude Code reads the file | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY_PASSPHRASE` | ✅ | Gives the passphrase of an encrypted client key. | Text. Used for the key check and the TLS agent | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅❌ | Docs: removed in v2.1.186 and now a no-op. The bundle only holds the name in name lists and nothing reads it. | A number of milliseconds. Docs point to `API_TIMEOUT_MS` and `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MTLS_RELOAD_ON_STALE_CONNECTION` | ✅ | Stops the re-read of the mTLS client cert and key after a connection-level API error. | On or off. Only matters when `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT` is set | MTLS setups |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` | ✅ | Turns off nonessential network traffic such as updates, telemetry and error reporting. | On or off | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK` | ✅ | Stops the non-streaming retry after a stream fails mid-stream. | On or off | All sessions. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING` | ✅🧪 | Forces tool input streaming on or off. Code matches the docs. | On, off, or unset. `0` is off. Else first party needs a feature flag, Vertex and Bedrock need model support and no custom base URL, `1` forces on | All sessions. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` | ✅ | Merges a JSON object into the top level of every API request body. | JSON text. Ignored when org policy blocks experimental betas. Passed on to background sessions | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_METADATA` | 🔍 | Merges a JSON object into the metadata of API requests. | JSON text. A bad value logs an error and is ignored | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS` | ✅🧪 | Sends or stops the gateway hint headers such as `x-claude-code-request-class`. | On, off, or unset. Unset sends them on some connections and else uses a feature flag on first party | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the timeout of the gateway `/v1/models` discovery request. | A number of milliseconds, `3000` by default. Whole number from `1` to `2147483647`, plain digits | Gateway setups with discovery on |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_CCR_REQUEST_BODIES` | 🔍 | Turns gzip of CCR worker request bodies on or off. | On, off, or unset. Used only for the `ccr_worker` source | Remote worker sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_DATADOG_LOGS` | 🔍 | Turns gzip of Datadog log batches on or off. | On, off, or unset, follows by default. A refusal turns it off for the process | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES` | ✅ | Turns gzip of request bodies to Anthropic on or off. Set `0` for a TLS-inspecting proxy. | On, off, or unset. Compression is skipped for a proxy, mTLS, a custom CA, or a Unix socket. Level comes from `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODY_LEVEL` | Direct Anthropic connections |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODY_BLOCKS` | 🔍🧪 | Sets the `blocks` gzip mode for large request bodies, from 524288 chars up. | A number, `0` by default. Whole number from `0` to `2`, plain digits. Only `1` and `2` act | Messages API requests |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODY_LEVEL` | 🔍🧪 | Sets the gzip level for request bodies. | A number, `0` by default. Whole number from `0` to `9`, plain digits. Only `1` to `9` act | All API requests |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_HTTP_PROXY_PORT` | 🔍 | The name sits in a list of env names next to the Linux sandbox HTTP and SOCKS bridge text. Nothing reads it, and a [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes) run saw no effect. | A number | Linux sandbox |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SOCKS_PROXY_PORT` | 🔍 | The name sits in a list of env names next to the Linux sandbox HTTP and SOCKS bridge text. Nothing reads it, and a [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes) run saw no effect. | A number | Linux sandbox |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HTTPS_PROXY` | 🔍 | Fallback HTTPS proxy. Used when `HTTPS_PROXY` and `https_proxy` are empty to build the proxy vars of child tools. | Text. Fills `YARN_*`, `npm_config_*`, and `GLOBAL_AGENT_*` proxy vars that are unset | All sessions, child process env |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HTTP_PROXY` | 🔍 | Fallback HTTP proxy. Used when `HTTP_PROXY` and `http_proxy` are empty to build the proxy vars of child tools. | Text. Fills `YARN_*`, `npm_config_*`, and `GLOBAL_AGENT_*` proxy vars that are unset | All sessions, child process env |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` | ✅ | Sets how many times a failed API request is retried. | A number. Whole number, `0` or more. Above the cap it is clamped with a warning unless the retry watchdog is on | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES` | ✅ | Limits the re-sends of a non-streaming request that times out. `0` fails on the first timeout. | A number. Whole number min `0`, digits only. Unset uses a built-in count only when the retry watchdog is on | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` | ✅ | Sets the first delay of the exponential backoff for retries of an overloaded API error. | A number of milliseconds. Whole number from `500` to `32000` in plain digits, else unset. Used only on the overloaded branch of the retry loop | All API requests |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` | ✅ | Sets the ceiling of the backoff for retries of an overloaded API error. | A number of milliseconds. Whole number from `32000` to `64000` in plain digits, else unset. A longer wait than the ceiling plus a margin raises a retry-after error | All API requests |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` | ✅ | Lets the proxy resolve DNS names. | On or off. When set the proxy agent `lookup` returns the host name as is | HTTP proxy setups |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` | ✅ | Retries `429` and `529` capacity errors without end for unattended sessions. Docs match the code path that reads it. | On or off. The self-hosted runner sets it to `1` and also clears `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES`. Docs also cover the spend-limit rule | Unattended runs, CI, remote workers. Set by Claude Code for self-hosted runners |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` | 🔍 | Caps the total ms the retry watchdog waits out usage-limit `429` errors. When the wait is longer than what is left, the request fails. | A number of milliseconds. Integer 1 or more, digits only. Unset means no limit | Sessions with the retry watchdog on |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` | ✅ | Caps the ms each API request spends waiting out `429` and `529` errors under the watchdog. After that the next error ends the request. | A number of milliseconds. Integer 1 or more, digits only. Unset means no limit | Sessions with `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`. Docs say v2.1.295 or later |
| `CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG` | ✅ | Forces the byte-level streaming idle watchdog on or off. | On, off, or unset, on by default. Unset uses a feature flag with default true. Direct, AWS, and gateway only | Anthropic API, AWS, gateway |
| `CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG_BEDROCK` | ✅ | Enables the byte-level streaming idle watchdog for Bedrock event streams. | On or off. Off by default. Needs the main watchdog to be on | Amazon Bedrock |
| `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG` | ✅ | Forces the event-level streaming idle watchdog on or off. It also sets the async agent stall time. | On, off, or unset, on by default | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_MOCK_HEADERLESS_429` | 🔍❌ | In the schema, but nothing reads it. | - | - |
| `CLAUDE_SLOW_FIRST_BYTE_MS` | 🔍 | Sets the wait before Claude Code logs a slow first byte on a stream. It does not abort. | A number of milliseconds | - |
| `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the first-byte deadline of a streaming request in ms. | A number of milliseconds | - |
| `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the idle timeout of the stream watchdogs in ms. | A number of milliseconds | - |
| `CLOUDSDK_CORE_CUSTOM_CA_CERTS_FILE` | 🔍 | Names a CA bundle file for `gcloud`. The Bash sandbox treats it as a CA bundle variable. | A path | - |
| `CURL_CA_BUNDLE` | 🔍 | Names a CA bundle for `curl`. The Bash sandbox treats it as a CA bundle variable. | - | - |
| `DENO_CERT` | 🔍 | Names a CA bundle for Deno. The Bash sandbox treats it as a CA bundle variable. | - | - |
| `GIT_SSL_CAINFO` | ✅ | Git CA bundle path. Claude Code names it in CA hints and in runner messages saying a server value replaces it in a session. | Text. Use is mostly by name in text and lists | Git. Self-hosted runner. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `GIT_SSL_CAPATH` | 🔍❌ | In the schema, but nothing reads it. | Text | Nowhere, nothing reads it |
| `HTTPS_PROXY` | ✅ | Sets the HTTPS proxy for Claude Code network traffic. | - | - |
| `HTTP_PROXY` | ✅ | Sets the HTTP proxy for Claude Code network traffic. | - | - |
| `NIX_SSL_CERT_FILE` | 🔍 | Set by Claude Code in sandboxed commands to the CA bundle path, with other CA vars. | A path | - |
| `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` | ✅ | Adds extra CA certificates from a PEM file to the trusted set. | - | - |
| `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED` | ✅ | Set to `0` to turn off TLS certificate checks (Bun). Claude Code counts any value except `1` as a trust override. | - | - |
| `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY` | 🔍 | Bun `http` client: a value other than empty or `0` makes it use `HTTP_PROXY` and `HTTPS_PROXY`. A bundled proxy tip names it for Node 22.21 and later. | - | - |
| `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA` | 🔍 | Bun runtime: `1` adds the OS CA store to the default CA list. | - | - |
| `NO_PROXY` | ✅ | Lists hosts that skip the proxy. `*` skips it for all. | On or off | - |
| `SSL_CERT_DIR` | 🔍 | Directory of CA certificates. Claude Code counts it as a custom CA setting. | Text. Raw string (`rawStr`). Together with `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` and `SSL_CERT_FILE`, it makes the TLS setup treat custom certs as set | All sessions |
| `SSL_CERT_FILE` | ✅ | CA bundle file path. Claude Code treats it as a custom CA setting, and passes it to proxy helpers and the MCP agent proxy. | Text. Raw string. The MCP agent proxy fallback reads the file as PEM | All sessions |
| `all_proxy` | 🔍 | Lower case proxy variable. It is the last fallback after `HTTPS_PROXY` and `ALL_PROXY` for git proxy settings. | Text. Non-empty string. Also listed with proxy names | All sessions |
| `http_proxy` | ✅ | Lower case HTTP proxy URL. Claude Code reads it as an alternative to `HTTP_PROXY`. | Text. Non-empty string. Order is `HTTP_PROXY`, this, then `CLAUDE_CODE_HTTP_PROXY` for the sandbox proxy | All sessions |
| `https_proxy` | ✅ | Lower case HTTPS proxy URL. Claude Code reads it as an alternative to `HTTPS_PROXY`. | Text. Non-empty string. Order is `HTTPS_PROXY`, this, then `CLAUDE_CODE_HTTPS_PROXY` for the sandbox proxy | All sessions |
| `no_proxy` | ✅ | Lower case proxy bypass list. Claude Code reads it with `NO_PROXY`. | A comma-separated list. If both are set and differ, Claude Code joins them with a comma | All sessions |
